q: The ability to upgrade Ava's accumulator to Ava's alerter.
tx:
The alerter is an upgraded version of Ava's accumulator that can be obtained during the Do No Evil quest. Full quest completion is not necessary to obtain this reward. In the quest, the player takes a metal crate to Ava in order to get a device that can detect buried metal items. She then takes your accumulator and adapts it to search for the exact same metal boxes.
Since it requires an Ava's accumulator to obtain, the minimum Ranged level needed to wear this item is 50.
If the alerter is lost it can be re-obtained from Ava by using the 'Buy Device' option and selecting the alerter. This will get players a new alerter (for 999 coins and 75 steel arrows).

During the quest, the undead chicken in Ava's alerter will squawk with increasing excitement as you get closer to a metal box. One "Bwuk!" means you are standing anywhere between nine and five squares from the box. "Bwuk! Bwuk!" means four, three or two squares. Three bwuks means one square, and four bwuks means you've found the buried treasure. Dig!

tx:
There are two safes inside the Black Knights' Fortress that the player can get to quickly by teleporting with the Skull of Rememberance, climbing down the staircase, and heading into the room located west.
By gazing into the skull, the following cutscenes can be rewatched:
• Saradomin's Arrival
• Deliberately Distressed Damsel
• Player's Sacrifice or Sir Owen's Sacrifice (depending on the player's decision during the quest)
• Knight of the Living Dead
• Righteous Fury or Saradomin's Gift (depending on the player's decision during the quest)
It can also be used on various items. The currently known items are:
• Using a gilded cabbage on it allows the players to remember your audience with Brassica Prime.
• Using it on Dawn's body allows the players to fight her again.
• Using Zilyana's Gift from The World Wakes quest or a commorb v2 on it allows the players to recall a conversation with Saradomin about his regret about the Naragi race. (If the players received Juna's or Azzanadra's Gift, they can return to the Guthixian High Druid to swap it for Zilyana's Gift.)
• Using it with the tapestry in the Black Knights' Fortress will replay Sir Owen's commentary about them.
Although high level players generally prefer the TokKul-Zo or the attuned crystal teleport seed for quickly teleporting to a bank, the Skull has a few advantages over it. For one, the TokKul-Zo requires completion of the quest The Elder Kiln, a quest with multiple high skill requirements, whereas the Skull only requires the completion of The Death of Chivalry, a free-to-play quest with no skill requirements. The Fight Caves destination from the TokKul-Zo is close to a fairy ring that allows for additional quick teleporting.…
